summary: Iter23: autocadastro selfie-only, solicitação imediata (sem agendar), mensagem de convite, tela de espera + Web Push. Backend: test_selfreg_now_invite_msg (3), test_selfreg_push (4), test_selfreg_flow (regressão) = 25 passed, 1 skipped (after updating 2 obsolete scheduling assertions + fixing fixture path). Frontend (390px): /v/<code> has only 'Tirar selfie' (no file input/'Escolher foto'), no Quando/Agendar block, 'A solicitação vai agora para o anfitrião...' text present; camera modal opens. /solicitacao/<token>: selfreg-waiting with animated spinner (animationName=spin), 'Aguardando aprovação', push-enable button; approve via API -> selfreg-status-aprovado in 5.0s; reject -> selfreg-status-recusado in 3.9s; polling stops after final state; no 429. /sw.js, /manifest.json, /icon-192.png, /favicon-32.png 200. Admin invite: invite-message textarea has Empresa/Anfitrião/Data-hora/Tipo/link, copy-message and copy-link write clipboard correctly, invite-whatsapp href=wa.me/?text=<msg>. Found 1 data bug (approved start_at shown stale), 1 missing UI field (Observações), 1 empty card on invite page.

minor.issue: On approval only end_at is copied from the visit to self_registrations, start_at is NOT. Status page/admin list then show submission time as start and approval+duration as end (seen: '02:29 até 10:31' for an 8h type). Fix: add "start_at": visit["start_at"] to the $set.

Rate limit is 240/10min per IP; the page polls every 5s (120/10min). Two waiting visitors behind the same NAT (e.g. lobby Wi-Fi) reach the limit, three or more get 429. Consider keying the limit by IP+token or raising it.

ui_bugs.issue: There is no 'Observações' (notes) input. The state has notes:'' but nothing renders it, so admins can never add notes and the 'Observações:' line never shows up in the invite message. The backend already supports it.
Empty bordered <Box> is rendered under the invite banner, because all its children are !isInvite. Wrap the Box at L232-236 with (!isInvite) or render it conditionally.

issues: Only selfreg-take-selfie has a data-testid. Consent checkbox, Começar, name/doc inputs, host search and the submit 'Enviar para aprovação' button have none.
Uses the browser's native datetime-local picker instead of a shadcn calendar (existing behaviour)

action_items: routers/selfreg.py _approve: also set start_at=visit['start_at'] on the self_registration so the status page/e-mail/admin lists are consistent
SelfRegAdmin InviteDialog: add a notes/Observações textarea bound to f.notes
SelfRegister.jsx: don't render the empty Box for invites
Add data-testids to SelfRegister (consent, start, inputs, host search, submit)
critical_code_review_comments: Environment note: the webpack dev server had NOT picked up the SelfStatus.jsx changes. The served bundle still had the old 'Você receberá um e-mail...' clock screen and no selfreg-waiting. I ran touch on SelfStatus.jsx/common.jsx/SelfRegAdmin.jsx to force a recompile. After that, verify edits are actually in the bundle.
test_selfreg_flow.py must be run with -n 0 (pytest-xdist in use splits the shared-state classes across workers, so pytest.selfreg_* attributes are missing)
send_push passes url '/' (unused; the SW opens the cached /__last_status URL). This is OK but redundant.
PushOptIn caches the status URL before asking for permission. This is harmless.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_selfreg_flow.py (FACE fixture path -> tests/fixtures/face.jpg; C3 end_at assertion updated to 'override ignored + drift <120s'; TestH now asserts start ~now and cancel returns 400 since scheduling was removed)

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows pass; 2 minor UI bugs)

Use backend/tests/ui_setup_iter23.py (setup -> submit N -> open /solicitacao/<token>, approve/reject via page.request with admin Bearer).
